name: list_collections
description: List accessible organization collections, called folders in the library UI. Returns bounded summaries and a next-page cursor.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Empty or omitted starts the first page.

name: get_collection
description: Read a folder and a bounded page of readable artifact references. Folder membership never grants artifact access.

id.description: Collection ID returned by list_collections or create_collection.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Empty or omitted starts the first page.

name: create_collection
description: Create an organization folder referencing existing artifacts. Duplicate names return a conflict; creation never silently updates an existing folder.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

color.description: Six-digit hex color, or empty string to clear.

cover_artifact_id.description: Readable collection member ID, or empty string to clear the cover.

artifact_ids.description: At most 100 readable artifact IDs from the same organization.

name: update_collection
description: Edit folder metadata. Omitted fields are preserved; empty description, color, or cover_artifact_id clears that field.

id.description: Collection ID returned by list_collections or create_collection.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

color.description: Six-digit hex color, or empty string to clear.

cover_artifact_id.description: Readable collection member ID, or empty string to clear the cover.

name: delete_collection
description: Delete a folder and its membership links. All underlying artifacts, revisions, and links in other folders are preserved. Missing folders return Not found.

id.description: Collection ID returned by list_collections or create_collection.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

name: add_artifacts_to_collection
description: Add readable same-organization artifact references to a folder. Safe to retry; all batch targets validate before any write.

id.description: Collection ID returned by list_collections or create_collection.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

artifact_ids.description: At most 100 readable artifact IDs from the same organization.

name: remove_artifacts_from_collection
description: Remove artifact references from a folder, preserving artifacts and other folders. Safe to retry; reports already-absent references.

id.description: Collection ID returned by list_collections or create_collection.

org.description: Concrete registered organization. Required for admin credentials; other credentials are locked to their own organization.

artifact_ids.description: At most 100 readable artifact IDs from the same organization.
